title: DOCATT attach entry has no defined field set for the document reference, the intake item, the match method, the confidence, the final call and the message id
source: TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3.1; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.1 to A2.3; RWB-E1-032 sections 7, 11 and 12
description: decision_log_entry of TSD P7 v2 T3.1 carries case_id, decision_code, rule_id, rule_version, model_version, agent_version, inputs_ref, recommendation, approver_user_id, approval_level, final_call, override_reason, actions, outcome, decided_at, prev_hash, entry_hash, chain_seq, corrects_entry_id, actor_user_id and idempotency_key. No source readable in this run names a document reference column, an intake item column, a match method column, a confidence column, a message id column or the final call value of an attach record, and the legacy story only says the DOCATT entry holds the model version, the confidence and the match method.
evidence: TSD P7 v2 T3.1 field list; legacy AC1 wording 'one decision log entry DOCATT holds model version CLS-1.0, confidence 0.93 and match method CASE_ID'; legacy section 11 has no decision_log_entry field mapping
proposed: Carry the document reference, the intake item and the match method in actions, the classifier version in model_version, the confidence and the type candidates in recommendation, the message id of a refusal in outcome, and final_call ATTACHED; add the columns by migration V1032_1 in rwb_decision

title: The decision code list in force does not enumerate DOCATT in any source readable here
source: TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3.2; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3; RWB-E1-032 section 11
description: decision_log_entry.decision_code is a LOV named LOV-DECISION, and TSD P7 v2 T3.2 lists LOV-APPROVAL-LEVEL, LOV-APPROVAL-STATUS, LOV-CAPABILITY and LOV-PRODUCT but not the values of LOV-DECISION. The legacy story names the DOCATT entry in its AC1, AC8, AC12 and section 11 without stating that DOCATT is a value of the list.
evidence: TSD P7 v2 T3.1 row DF-DEC-003 (LOV LOV-DECISION); TSD P7 v2 T3.2 has no LOV-DECISION row; legacy AC1 and AC12
proposed: Hold DOCATT as a value of LOV-DECISION in force and read it through the rwb-case reference-data contract at the version in force; an unknown code is refused with MSG-P7-009

title: Whether an item held for a person leaves a decision record is not stated
source: RWB-E1-032 sections 4, 5, 7 and 9; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.2
description: The legacy story holds an item as NO_MATCH, MULTIPLE, CONFLICT, CASE_CLOSED or NO_TYPE and states that no document row is written, but it does not state whether the hold itself is a decision that leaves a DOCATT entry. FSD P7 v3 A2.2 writes one entry for every decision the Workbench or a person takes.
evidence: Legacy AC2, AC3, AC5, AC6, AC7 and AC11 assert no document row and say nothing about the decision log; legacy X13 covers only the failed write
proposed: Write no DOCATT entry for a held item or a refused attach, because no document was stored; the hold stays a status on the intake item in rwb_document

title: The DecisionRecorded payload of an attach has no defined field set
source: RWB-P5-E1032-CON section 12.3; Arch v5 slide 42; TSD P7 v2 T5.3
description: The contract of rwb-document declares the DOCATT record on rwb.decision-record.v1 with the decision code, the match method, the classifier version and the confidence, and no source fixes the payload field names of the fact, nor whether the document reference travels on the fact or is read through the document contract.
evidence: RWB-P5-E1032-CON AC7 and 12.3; TSD P7 v2 T5.3 names DecisionRecorded as published without a schema
proposed: Fact keyed by caseId and carrying decisionCode, caseId, documentId, intakeItemId, matchMethod, classifierVersion, confidence, approverUserId, finalCall, messageId and inputsRef; no OCR text, no file and no account number; a fact without a document reference is refused

title: The metadata dependency rows name only the P5 contract, while the DP table adds platform and rwb-case and rwb-access contracts

description: The work package fixes Depends on (build) = none, Contract dependencies = RWB-P5-E1032-CON and the I and X lists empty. The DP table of the ten patterns adds H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, H RWB-PLT-E1042-CON, H RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, H RWB-PLT-TE006-CON, H RWB-PLT-E1071-CON, H RWB-PLT-E1044-CON, H RWB-PLT-N001-CON, C RWB-P3-E1042-CON, C RWB-P3-E1043-CON and the authorise contract RWB-P4-E1037-CON.
evidence: WP story line H/C/I/X; Template and Rules v1 section R5.5 rows DP-03, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-10, DP-11, DP-15, DP-19

title: Login name, parameter names and message texts are not written in any source readable here
source: TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3, T-A; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3
description: The per-service database login name, the parameter names of the ledger ingest target and the chain-check time, and the texts of MSG-P7-009 and MSG-GEN-006 are not written out in the FSD and TSD P7 files, the context pack or the legacy story.
evidence: TSD P7 v2 T3 and appendix T-A; FSD P7 v3 exception flow text names MSG-P7-009 and MSG-GEN-006 without writing their text
proposed: Use the phrase 'the rwb-decision login (DP-02)', keep the placeholder for the parameter names and both message texts, and read the parameters through the rwb-case parameters contract

title: The trigger of the ledger completeness check is not stated
source: Arch v5 slide 28; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.1.4.4; RWB-E1-032 section 12
description: JOB-12 runs the intake every 15 minutes in business hours and JOB-14 checks the hash chain nightly at 02:00. No source states whether the comparison of the documents of a case with the DOCATT entries of the case runs on its own timer, on the ingest window or on demand.
evidence: Legacy section 12 job table names JOB-12 only; FSD P7 v3 AC-BG-P7-001-01 names the nightly chain check only
proposed: Run the check on the ledger ingest window of DP-06 with no Temporal Schedule and no cron entry of this service
